html:
Shift every ASCII English letter by k positions modulo 26, preserving letter case. Leave other characters unchanged; k may be negative.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "Az-z!",
    2
  ],
  "expected": "Cb-b!"
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "abc",
    -1
  ],
  "expected": "zab"
}
Hint

Use separate origins for uppercase and lowercase letters.

Complexity: O(n) time and output space
